exposure: elevated TSH at the second neonatal screening
normal TSH levels at the initial screening
cohort: 100 newborns with dTSH and 200 matched controls without dTSH in eight university-affiliated neonatal intensive care units (NICUs)
finding: Patent ductus arteriosus (PDA) and administration of vancomycin, insulin, and furosemide are independent risk factors for delayed thyrotropin (dTSH) in newborns.
